'''Mikako Komatsu''' (Japanese: '''小松未可子''' ''Komatsu Mikako'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. Her only role in ''Pokémon the Series'' was of [[Mairin]]. She was born on November 11, 1988 in {{wp|Kuwana, Mie|Kuwana}}, {{wp|Mie Prefecture|Mie}}, {{wp|Japan}}.
